finalText:
All 4 tests pass now.

The leak was in `src/jobs/processOrder.js`. It called `pool.release(conn)` as a plain line after `await run(...)`, so any order that failed validation skipped the release entirely — the connection just stayed marked in-use forever. Your logs match exactly: pool in-use crept 2→5 as `worker-1` chewed through bad orders, then `pool exhausted` errors, then the fatal restarts in both `worker-1` and the API.

`api.js` was fine — it already goes through `withConnection`, which releases in a `finally`. I gave `processOrder` the same `try/finally` shape.

Worth a glance: `pool.js`'s docstring says there's no timeout-based reclaim, so any future direct `acquire()` call anywhere else in the codebase is a latent copy of this same bug.
